title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Trials
indian_angle: This administrative update directly impacts the selection process for India's junior women's doubles pairs aiming for the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a change in the women's doubles pair composition for the upcoming selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Junior National Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This coaching camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is crucial for nurturing young Indian talent and preparing them for international competition.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BWF World Junior Championships Final Selection Trials Details Out
indian_angle: This announcement provides the essential details for Indian junior players regarding their eligibility and qualification for the final trials to represent the nation at the World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released information on player eligibility and the list of qualified players for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt.

title: Bhubaneswar U-19 Tournament Now World Junior Selection Event
indian_angle: This calendar change significantly impacts Indian U-19 players, as the Bhubaneswar tournament now serves as a key pathway for World Junior Championships selection.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, and the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament has been declared as the new selection tournament for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This major rule change will directly affect how U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships are played across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: All India Senior Ranking Tournament Held in Chennai
indian_angle: This tournament provided a crucial platform for senior Indian badminton players to compete, earn ranking points, and showcase their skills on the national stage.
summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026 was conducted in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd, as per a circular from the BAI.
